newsitem.title: JAPAN: Engine sharing report boosts Mazda shares.
newsitem.headline: Engine sharing report boosts Mazda shares.

text.p: Media reports saying Mazda Motor Corp and Ford Motor Co have agreed to share engines gave Mazda shares a boost in early Thursday trade, brokers said.
As of 0040 GMT, the shares were up 16 yen at 377 yen, making them the seventh largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Mazda will develop engines for small vehicles and Ford will do the same for larger cars with the hope of cutting development costs.
Mazda will develop an 4-cylinder model with a displacement of 1,800cc-2,000cc as the first engine to be developed under the scheme, the paper said.
A spokesman for Mazda was not immediately available to comment on the report.
